in_marathi.name: Prathik
in_marathi.long_meaning: Prathik हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Prathik means 'thinker' or 'observer'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'pratha' which means 'to think' or 'to ponder'. The name is a reflection of the individual's deep introspective nature, making them a thoughtful and insightful person.
